provenance.note: Table III-B, Area irrigated by different sources, pages 125-131 of the DES Season and Crop Report 2024-25 (PDF sha256 49bbd356b1aab315a53e9a62ef0ba9a124a90c5975231146fb1bab0498f7eb75, Google Drive file 1uONHRwuvU9-EhDGD1v0XC0OWqAVOZtV6 from the DES listing): the Thanjavur row (Sl. No. 24), net area irrigated per source with the report's printed net total, gross total, area irrigated more than once and irrigation intensity, read into a reviewed extraction (pipeline-inputs/atlas/tn/thanjavur/irrigation-des.json) and validated here. Supplementary wells water land already counted under another source and are recorded separately, never added to the net total.

conventions.units: hectares, whole, as the report prints them; shares in percent of the printed net total, one decimal
conventions.edition: 2024-25 is the report's agricultural year, not a publication date
conventions.supplementary_wells: not a component of the net total; they supplement land under other sources
conventions.rounding: component sums may miss the printed net total by up to 2 ha of the report's own rounding; the printed total is served

supplementaryWells.note: The report's supplementary-wells column ('by all other types of wells') waters land already counted under the sources above, so its 21,468 ha net is recorded separately and never added to the net total.

notes: The five source components sum to the printed net total exactly (131263 + 0 + 54803 + 0 + 0 = 186066).
Gross 285787 ha minus net 186066 ha equals the printed 99721 ha irrigated more than once.
